abiJson.author: LOOP
abiJson.description: Address-bound TON escrow with a guaranteed boost response window, commit-reveal and holder fee permits

declarations.name: HolderFeePermit
declarations.description:
Backend Ed25519 proof that the offer owner holds PLUSH BRICK. The permit is
domain-separated and bound to the network, contract, offer id, owner wallet
and expiry, so it cannot be replayed for another player or deployment. A
valid permit marks the offer fee-exempt: if it wins, no protocol fee is
withheld from the payout.

declarations.name: OpenDirectOffer
declarations.description:
Opens a Telegram direct invite. `inviteId` is public and only identifies
the invite; acceptance still requires a backend Ed25519 permit bound to the
accepting wallet address.

declarations.name: AcceptDirectOffer
declarations.description:
Atomically opens the invited wallet's complementary offer, verifies its
address-bound permit and matches the pair.

declarations.name: BoostDuel
declarations.description:
Adds a verified amount to one side of a matched duel while its boost window is open.
`expectedRevision` and `minChanceBps` protect wallet transactions from stale ordering.

declarations.name: DuelPayout
declarations.description: Attached to every terminal winner transfer so indexers can project the result.

declarations.name: OfferRefund
declarations.description: Attached to unmatched or no-reveal refunds.

declarations.name: ProtocolFee
declarations.description: Attached to the protocol fee transfer.

import "errors"

const OFFER_OPEN = 1
const OFFER_MATCHED = 2

const REVEALED_A = 1
const REVEALED_B = 2

type OfferMap = map<uint64, Cell<OfferData>>

type DuelMap = map<uint64, Cell<DuelData>>

type ActiveOfferMap = map<address, uint64>

type UsedOfferMap = map<uint64, bool>

struct DirectOfferData {
    inviteId: uint256
    opponent: address?
}

struct OfferData {
    owner: address
    commitment: uint256
    chanceBps: uint16
    totalPool: coins
    stake: coins
    expiresAt: uint32
    state: uint8
    feeExempt: bool
    direct: Cell<DirectOfferData>
}

struct DuelData {
    offerAId: uint64
    offerBId: uint64
    boostDeadline: uint32
    hardDeadline: uint32
    revealDeadline: uint32
    boostRevision: uint16
    secretA: uint256
    secretB: uint256
    revealedMask: uint8
}

struct Storage {
    owner: address
    treasury: address
    feeBps: uint16
    networkId: int32
    inviteSignerPublicKey: uint256
    paused: bool
    locked: coins
    offers: OfferMap
    duels: DuelMap
    activeOffers: ActiveOfferMap
    usedOfferIds: UsedOfferMap
}

struct ContractConfigView {
    owner: address
    treasury: address
    feeBps: uint16
    networkId: int32
    inviteSignerPublicKey: uint256
    contractAddress: address
    paused: bool
    locked: coins
    holderFeeSupported: bool
}

struct DuelAdminStateView {
    owner: address
    treasury: address
    feeBps: uint16
    paused: bool
    locked: coins
}

struct DuelBoostView {
    stakeA: coins
    stakeB: coins
    chanceABps: uint16
    chanceBBps: uint16
    boostDeadline: uint32
    hardDeadline: uint32
    revealDeadline: uint32
    boostRevision: uint16
}

fun Storage.load(): Storage {
    return Storage.fromCell(contract.getData());
}

fun Storage.save(self) {
    contract.setData(self.toCell());
}

fun Storage.loadOffer(self, offerId: uint64): OfferData {
    return self.offers.mustGet(offerId, Errors.OfferMissing).load();
}

fun Storage.loadDuel(self, duelId: uint64): DuelData {
    return self.duels.mustGet(duelId, Errors.DuelMissing).load();
}
